<script>
import mpx, { createApp } from '@mpxjs/core'
import apiProxy from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'

mpx.use(apiProxy)
createApp({})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/home/index",
    "pages/orders/index",
    "pages/checkout/index",
    "pages/address/select",
    "pages/pay/result",
    "pages/login/index"
  ],
  "tabBar": {
    "list": [
      {"pagePath": "pages/home/index", "text": "首页"},
      {"pagePath": "pages/orders/index", "text": "订单"}
    ]
  }
}
</script>
<template>
  <view class="checkout">
    <navigator url="/pages/address/select" open-type="navigateTo">选择地址</navigator>
    <view wx:if="{{address}}">{{address.name}} {{address.detail}}</view>
    <button bindtap="pay">支付</button>
    <button bindtap="openOrders">查看订单</button>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: { address: null },
  onShow () {
    const pages = getCurrentPages()
    const current = pages[pages.length - 1]
    if (current.data.selectedAddress) this.address = current.data.selectedAddress
  },
  methods: {
    chooseAddress () {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/address/select' })
    },
    pay () {
      mpx.redirectTo({ url: '/pages/pay/result' })
    },
    openOrders () {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/orders/index' })
    },
    requireLogin () {
      mpx.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login/index' })
    }
  }
})
</script>
<template>
  <view>
    <view wx:for="{{addresses}}" wx:key="id" bindtap="confirm(item)">{{item.name}} {{item.detail}}</view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    addresses: [
      { id: 'home', name: '家', detail: '幸福路 1 号' },
      { id: 'office', name: '公司', detail: '科技路 8 号' }
    ]
  },
  methods: {
    confirm (address) {
      const pages = getCurrentPages()
      pages[pages.length - 2].setData({ selectedAddress: address })
      mpx.navigateBack({ delta: 1 })
    }
  }
})
</script>
const path = require('path')

module.exports = {
  publicPath: '/',
  pluginOptions: {
    mpx: {
      plugin: {
        webRouteConfig: {
          mode: 'hash',
          base: '/'
        },
        srcMode: 'wx'
      }
    }
  },
  configureWebpack: {
    resolve: { alias: { '@': path.resolve(__dirname, 'src') } }
  }
}

item.text: 已确认问题集中在两处：地址选择不应依赖 Web 下易失真的页面栈回写，应改用 `navigateTo` 的 EventChannel；订单 tabBar 必须使用 `switchTab`。登录失效继续清栈进入登录页，支付完成继续替换结算页；Web 路由改为 `/shop/` 基座下的 history 模式，全程不直接操作浏览器 history。
已完成，4 个完整文件已写入 `outputs/`。
